replaces: The file committed at 7f2432066b019c3d5c1a4782a91d7fe53b232ed2 (2026-10-25) under this name. certificate: The only certificate for any commit of this repository is the official GitHub Actions artifact 'kernel-certificate' of the workflow .github/workflows/kernel-certificate.yml run on that commit (lake-manifest.json and its sha256, toolchain and elan/lake/lean versions, the full lake build log, the sorry/axiom scan, #print axioms output and the external leanchecker re-check), together with the artifact 'truth-gate-report' of .github/workflows/truth-gate.yml.
